explication: Ladder is an HTTP proxy for testing how websites deliver content under modified client conditions. A browser or API client enters a target URL; Fiber dispatches it through optional authentication, URL handling, ruleset matching, request customization, and origin fetching. Responses are rewritten and returned as browsable HTML, raw HTML, or structured API data. Rulesets load from local YAML or remote sources. The sampled code confirms the main proxy path and integrations; some response-modification details are inferred only from the documented capabilities.
